title: LiveEngines — Technical systems, made interactive
hero.hero-content.hero__sub-row.hero__su: We turn industrial processes, technical products, and engineering phenomena into
interactive web experiences you can explore
statement.statement__grid.problem-callou: The engine can appear in a PDF. A process can be explained in a video. A plant can be reduced to a diagram.
We believe exploring and interacting works better. We turn technical information into interactive experiences for your website or platform. Let your audience actually understand what you do.
transform-section.transform-header.p: Same content, different understanding. Each example shows the concrete advantage of making it explorable.

faq.faq-header.p: The usual questions before you start.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-q.span: 01 — How is this different from a 3D render?
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p: We don’t compete on photorealism. A simple model that explains the system is worth more than a cinematic one that distracts. Our value is
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-q.span.2: 02 — Can you use my CAD / BIM / drawings?
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.3: Yes. STEP, FBX, OBJ, GLTF/GLB, drawings, and renders all work as source. We adapt and optimize them for the web. If you don’t have a model, we build a simplified one procedurally.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-q.span.3: 03 — How long does it take and how do you work?
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.4: Discovery → technical script → prototype → development → optimization → validation → deployment.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.5: An Explore takes days, an Experience 2–4 weeks. We validate interaction early.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.7: and labeled as such. The visual model is kept separate from the calculation model for performance. It does not replace FEA/CFD or SCADA.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-q.span.5: 05 — Which industries, and what do you deliver?
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.8: Mining, energy, manufacturing, water, infrastructure, science. Deliverables: a responsive web experience, integration into your site, optimized assets, documentation of limits, and an optional maintenance plan.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.9: Explore US$800–1.5k / Experience 1.5–3.5k / Simulate 3–6k / Connect 5–10k+. Basic maintenance 100–250/mo, Technical 250–500/mo. Modular, reusable scope.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.10: A working URL with the interactive experience ready to use. Not a video, not a loose 3D model, not a file for you to configure. Users open it in any browser and explore directly. We deliver
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-q.span.8: 08 — What if I already have a website?
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.16: Embedded as a full section in your current page. The experience lives inside your digital ecosystem.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-q.span.9: 09 — What if I DON’T have a website?
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.17: You don’t need to hire a web agency first. We offer
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.18: : a lightweight site designed specifically to host your experience. It includes domain, hosting, SSL, and maintenance. The experience is the protagonist, not the corporate site.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.19: LiveEngines manages the hosting: global CDN, SSL certificates, deployment, optimization, monitoring, and maintenance. You don’t manage Vercel, AWS, servers, or updates. You provide the information and assets; we make sure the experience is online.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.22: LiveEngines registers and configures the domain as part of the project, but ownership stays in your name. We don’t create artificial dependency on our infrastructure.
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-q.span.12: 12 — Does it work for trade shows, presentations, and mobile sharing?
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.23: Yes. We deliver a standalone URL (
faq.faq-list.faq-item.faq-a.p.24: ) and a QR code. It works on phones, tablets, touchscreens, and laptops. We can also prepare a portable version optimized for offline use at events. No conversion to video.
manifesto.manifesto-inner.manifesto-left: How we think about the work.
It’s not 3D to look impressive. It’s 3D when it improves understanding.
A simple, correct model beats a complex one that distracts.
Every interaction answers: what does this component do? What happens if the load changes?
Quality isn’t measured in polygons but in fidelity to the system.
No apps, no installations. It lives in the browser.
Only the infrastructure the problem requires; reusable components.
manifesto.manifesto-inner.manifesto-righ: “We are not trying to represent every bolt. We are trying to represent the system that matters, correctly.”
The model you visualize doesn’t have to be the one that calculates. One simplified for the browser, one mathematical for the simulation. That’s how we get performance, control, and reuse.
